Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE COMPLETE coherent landscape 16:9 scientific figure, not a collage. Elegant publication-quality light ivory paper, cobalt blue and cyan accents, navy typography, fine clear lines and restrained three-dimensional reactor / molecular motifs. Compact but airy structure, readable at GitHub README width. Fill the lower region with meaningful labelled content, no blank lower half. No fake plots or measured values. Exact English text, crisp formulas. Every image must visibly say "AI-generated schematic · not measured data". This illustrates software, not an executed licensed Aspen run.
Title: "AspenOps · Controlled process execution".
Subtitle: "One control plane · explicit physical checks · traceable evidence".
A balanced left-to-right central architecture with FOUR main numbered stations and a clear return loop:
01 "Declare" — "CLI / MCP", "Units · bounds · registry", a structured request document and polymer/process motif.
02 "Govern" — "Policy · dry-run · budgets", "SQLite queue · bounded workers", a precise scheduling/controller panel.
03 "Execute" — "Private model snapshots", "Isolated workers", a reactor and distillation column connected to one separated external box labelled "Licensed Windows Aspen Plus / HYSYS". Also show a small separate tag "Mock: software tests".
04 "Verify" — four short stacked gates "Communication", "Engine", "Convergence", "Constraints + balances"; then an evidence bundle with "SHA-256 · optional Ed25519".
Below the central pipeline, a narrow feedback loop labelled "Bounded search population · feasibility first" loops candidate results toward governed requests. Do not call candidates feasible before checks.
Bottom technical ribbon contains three concise labelled relations:
"Capacity: W = min(W_request, W_max, L)"
"Acceptance: ok = C ∧ E ∧ V ∧ F"
"Balance: r = Σ_i c_i q_i − b"
The four symbols in acceptance denote communication, engine, convergence and feasibility. Capacity L is declared license slots, not discovered entitlement. Add readable small text: "Terms use a common unit; invalid numerical evidence is rejected".
Footer: "IR validation does not authorize execution. Planned DWSIM / IDAES / Modelica adapters remain unavailable."
Keep plant art small, labels dominant, all arrows scientifically clear. No arbitrary code generation or license-capacity inference.

Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE COMPLETE coherent landscape 16:9 scientific figure, not a collage. Elegant publication-quality light ivory paper, cobalt blue and cyan accents, navy typography, fine clear lines and restrained three-dimensional reactor / molecular motifs. Title: "AspenOps · Search, balance, accept".
Subtitle: "Implemented numerical contracts · bounded candidates are not guaranteed feasible".
Arrange THREE top panels and THREE bottom panels, connected by sparse thin arrows.
Top left "1 · Normalize objectives": show exactly "z_j = σ_j (y_j − r_j) / s_j" and "J = Σ_j w_j z_j". Small text "s_j > 0, w_j > 0; σ_j = +1 minimize, −1 maximize". "Convert readbacks to declared units first."
Top middle "2 · Bounded differential evolution": show exactly "v_d = a_d + F_m (b_d − c_d)" and "x_d ∈ [ℓ_d, h_d]". Small motif of bounded candidate points with NO numeric axes. Text "DE/rand/1/bin · forced mutation dimension".
Top right "3 · Feasibility ordering": "Feasible precedes infeasible"; "Feasible: compare objective"; "Infeasible: compare violation". Small text "No global-optimum guarantee".
Bottom left "4 · Dimensioned balance": show "r = fsum(c_1 q_1, …, c_n q_n, −b)" and "S = max(Σ_i |c_i q_i|, f)". Show "ρ = |r| / S". Small text "Common base unit; S excludes |b|; require S > 0".
Bottom middle "5 · Acceptance": show "(|r| ≤ a_tol) OR (ρ ≤ r_tol)". The word OR must be visibly emphasized. Above the equation place "Only after finite-value and underflow checks". Below: "r, S, f, a_tol: same unit; ρ, r_tol: dimensionless".
Bottom right "6 · Evaluation budget": show "G* = min(G, floor((B − P)/P))" and "N_eval = P(1 + G*) ≤ B". Small text "P ≥ 4, B ≥ P; complete generations only". Also "Candidate evaluations ≠ physical solver calls".
One compact bottom footer: "Canonical-equilibrium formulas are theoretical context, not this optimizer's sampling law." Keep formulas large and separated. Do not insert an incorrect additive tolerance formula or include expected target b in the scale.

Use case: scientific-educational.
Create ONE complete, polished landscape 16:9 scientific roadmap illustration for the seven SUNHAOJUN22 repositories. This is an AI-generated explanatory schematic, not a data plot. It must look like a clear publication figure with an elegant light ivory background, fine dark typography, subtle physical 3D motifs, compact editorial composition, and color-coded panels. All areas, including the bottom, must contain meaningful organized content; no empty lower half. Avoid glowing sci-fi clutter, robot faces, fake numerical plots, fake logos, or collages.
Title, exact: "PHYSICS-GUIDED SCIENTIFIC WORKFLOW"
Subtitle, exact: "Seven independent repositories • proposed interfaces"
Use seven distinct readable cards, in two balanced rows (four above, three below), with thin DOTTED connecting lines identified by the small legend "Dotted links: proposed handoffs". Do not imply these integrations are already implemented.
Cards and exact body text:
1 "TsaoSciResearcher" in burgundy/rose. "Question → evidence → qualified claim". Small motif: connected evidence records.
2 "TsaoSciComputation" in teal/navy. "Model → execution → verification". Small motif: continuum mesh and molecule.
3 "TsaoDFT_skill" in violet/blue. "Electronic structure → reaction energetics". Small motif: electron-density-inspired orbital.
4 "ResinDB-Pro-by-SunHJ" in amber/petrol. "Quantity + unit + condition → materials decision". Small motif: polymer chain and database.
5 "AspenOps-Agent" in cobalt/cyan. "Validated process intent → licensed solver → engineering review". Small motif: restrained reactor/column flowsheet.
6 "TSAO-PROCESSING-SKILL" in emerald/copper. "Kinetics → transport → processing reference". Small motif: flow channel and polymer chains.
7 "OpenDeepMind_skill" in indigo/gold. "Foundations → first principles → validation". Add small text "TRIZ: explicit opt-in". Small motif: clean branching hypothesis lattice.
Below the cards, a beautiful full-width slim mathematical ribbon headed "Equilibrium context · fixed N, V, T". Set these four short equations precisely and legibly:
"β = 1/(k_B T)"
"Z = Σ_i exp(−β E_i)"
"p_i = exp(−β E_i)/Z"
"F = −k_B T ln Z"
A small line directly below defines "T > 0; E_i: state energy; k_B: Boltzmann constant".
A second very compact footer text strip: "Units • finite values • conservation • uncertainty • traceable evidence".
A final small clearly readable footer at bottom right: "AI-generated schematic • illustrative, not measured data".
The formulas are theoretical context; do not place fake benchmark claims or scores. Draw the entire figure as one coherent generated raster. Every card has a concise caption, no blank panels. English spelling must be exact; legible at README width. Hierarchy: title, seven cards, equation ribbon, footer. Keep the roadmap simple with ample breathing room inside this compact structure.
